summary: Iteration 10 - Lot 4 Frontend & Backend Testing Complete. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all Lot 4 features: Live streaming (demo mode), Mass messaging (broadcast), Paid media in DMs, Subscription bundles 1/3/6/12 months.
critical_code_review_comments: All Lot 4 backend endpoints working correctly: /api/live/*, /api/creators/me/broadcast, /api/messages/{id}/unlock, /api/creators/{id}/bundles, /api/payments/subscribe-bundle
LiveKit is in DEMO MODE (LIVEKIT_ENABLED=False) - live room shows 'mode démo' fallback instead of WebRTC video
Live endpoints: POST /live/start (creator only), GET /live/active, GET /live/{id}, POST /live/{id}/join (PPV flow), POST /live/{id}/chat, POST /live/{id}/tip, POST /live/{id}/stop - all working
Broadcast endpoint: POST /creators/me/broadcast distributes message to active subscribers with optional paid media attachment
Message unlock: POST /messages/{id}/unlock debits coins and reveals media_url, GET /messages/{creator_id} returns is_unlocked flag
Bundles: GET /creators/{id}/bundles returns 4 options (1/3/6/12 months) with 0/10/20/30% discounts, POST /payments/subscribe-bundle creates subscription
Frontend /live page shows active lives list with empty state, creator sees 'Passer en direct' button
Frontend /live/start form has title, description, PPV toggle with coin presets (25/50/100/250)
Frontend /live/:sessionId shows demo mode fallback, chat panel, tip modal with presets (25/50/100/250/500), host has 'Terminer le live' button
Dashboard has 'Go Live' (red) and 'Message groupé' (magenta) buttons, BroadcastModal works with file uploader and paywall presets
CreatorProfile shows 'Économise jusqu'à -30% avec un pack' button, BundleModal displays 4 bundle options with discount badges
Messages page shows locked media with blur + Lock icon + 'Déverrouiller · X coins' button
Navbar has Live link with red pulse dot on desktop and mobile ('🔴 Lives en direct')
Fan correctly forbidden from /live/start with message 'Seules les créatrices peuvent lancer un live'
seed_data_creation: Test messages with paid media created during testing
